definition: Full-quality validity includes all canonical trials, including failures/timeouts. Completed timing quantiles condition on execution completion and must be read with timeout rates. Original90s timeout attempts are failures under uniform15s budget; raw spent time remains recorded. Layout checkpoints are partial engine evidence only and never receive fabricated routes or full-quality scores. Cache may reduce wall timing for identical geometry; see task/runtime logs.
